symbols.name: position set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of positions on which a permutation acts.
symbols.quote: Here $W$ is a finite set of positions, and $\sigma$ is the permutation, the map that sends each position to its new position.

symbols.name: permutation
symbols.meaning: The map from W to W that sends each position to its new position.
symbols.quote: Here $W$ is a finite set of positions, and $\sigma$ is the permutation, the map that sends each position to its new position.

symbols.name: address
symbols.meaning: The position of one entry of an array.
symbols.quote: Write $\xi$ for an address, the position of one entry of an array.

symbols.name: array
symbols.meaning: An array whose entries are stored at addresses.
symbols.quote: Let $G$ be an array whose entries are stored at addresses.

symbols.name: moved array
symbols.meaning: The array holding the entries of G at their new addresses under the permutation.
symbols.quote: The moved array $G'$ holds the same entries at the new addresses, so $G'(\sigma(\xi))=G(\xi)$ for every address $\xi$.

symbols.name: first entry
symbols.meaning: The entry of the sequence at position 1.
symbols.quote: Here $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\delta$ are four entries of a sequence, one at each of the positions $1,2,3,4$; these letters change meaning here.

symbols.name: second entry
symbols.meaning: The entry of the sequence at position 2.
symbols.quote: Here $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\delta$ are four entries of a sequence, one at each of the positions $1,2,3,4$; these letters change meaning here.

symbols.quote: Here $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\delta$ are four entries of a sequence, one at each of the positions $1,2,3,4$; these letters change meaning here.

relations.quote: A permutation of $W$ is defined as a [bijection](bijection.md) of $W$ onto itself: a map $\sigma$ from $W$ to $W$ that is one-to-one (no two positions have the same image) and onto (every position is an image).
